custody.boundary: procedural / workspace-based, NOT a kernel security boundary (all processes share one OS user)
access: private-item authors explicitly assigned to Phase 6
private-item reviewers explicitly assigned to Phase 6
denied: all Round 1 architecture leads and workers
the independent freeze reviewer unless explicitly assigned as custodian reviewer

paired_regime_b.note: Paired condition on the SAME questions: Regime A (source documents were available for corpus-specific adaptation) vs Regime B (those documents were EXCLUDED from architecture adaptation while the query-time corpus is unchanged). Report A-on-paired, B-on-same-paired, and the delta. Never pool the two as separate random populations.
